June 17, 1971

csc

Mr. J. H. Sherrill, Jr.

Re: VANTAGE MENTHOL (MRD # 71-0197)

C

This reports data from the VANTAGE Menthol CAS by billboard and non-billboard cities.

BACKGROUND: VANTAGE Menthol went "down-the-street" on May 3, 1971, supported by national print advertising - magazine, Sunday supplement, and newspaper - and outdoor advertising in 38 metro areas (see second page attached).

DISCUSSION: Through the first six weeks of advertising, the differences in consumers' awareness and usage of VANTAGE Menthol between cities with and without outdoor support is quite small. Awareness of the brand in cities with outdoor support (29%) was only slightly higher than in the ballance of the U.S. (22%).

In general, product usage has been low in both market types, with there being almost no difference between them.
Supporting data are reported in the first page attached. If you have any questions, please see me.

Joseph Ottaviani
Marketing Research Department
